subject: [video] WP05 real-encoder integration reached WP03 and found a WP03 ASan bug
body: WP05's real path now builds avc/*.c and runs. It aborts under ASan in WP03 before producing a frame: n2avc_intra_mb writes coef[16..23] but declares int16_t coef[16][16] (n2avc_mb.c:97 vs :135-141), ASan stack-buffer-overflow via n2avc_quant4x4_ac/n2avc_xform.c:117. Reported to WP03 with the fix. Our stub suite remains 736/736 green; no WP05 file needs changing for this. Once WP03 fixes it, the same command will exercise the actual 10x176x144 ffmpeg decode.
